provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: God created the world
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state that God created the world.
The pupils should be able to thank God for creation.
Introduction:
We see many things around us.
Today we learn who made all things.
Content:
God created the world.
God made the sky.
God made the land.
God made the water.
God made all plants and animals.
We should thank God for creation.
Class activity:
Let us thank God for creation.
Thank you God for the sun.
Thank you God for the trees.
Evaluation questions:
Who created the world?
Name one thing God created.
Why should we thank God?
Summary:
God created the world and all things in it.

topics.title: God created me
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state that God created them.
The pupils should be able to say thank you prayers.
Introduction:
We are special because God made us.
Today we learn that God created us.
Content:
God created me.
God made my eyes.
God made my hands.
God made my legs.
God made me special.
We should thank God for creating us.
Class activity:
Let us say thank you prayers.
Thank you God for making me.
Thank you God for my family.
Evaluation questions:
Who created you?
What did God create?
How do we thank God?
Summary:
God created me and I thank Him.

topics.title: God loves me
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state that God loves them.
The pupils should be able to sing about God's love.
Introduction:\ God loves us very much.
Today we learn about God's love.
Content:
God loves me.
God cares for me.
God protects me.
God provides for me.
God's love is like the sun.
We can sing about God's love.
Class activity:
Let us sing about God's love.
Jesus loves me this I know.
For the Bible tells me so.
Evaluation questions:
Does God love you?
How does God show His love?
What song can we sing about God's love?
Summary:
God loves me and cares for me.

topics.title: My family is God's gift
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to thank God for family.
The pupils should be able to pray for family.
Introduction:
Our family is important to us.
Today we learn that family is God's gift.
Content:
God gave us family.
Family includes father, mother, brothers and sisters.
God wants us to love our family.
We should thank God for family.
We should pray for our family.
Class activity:
Let us pray for our family.
Thank you God for my father.
Thank you God for my mother.
Evaluation questions:
Who gave us family?
Name one member of your family.
How do we thank God for family?
Summary:
Family is God's gift and we thank Him for it.

topics.title: Talking to God
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to say simple morning prayers.
The pupils should be able to say thank you prayers.
Introduction:
We can talk to God through prayer.
Today we learn how to pray.
Content:
Prayer is talking to God.
We can pray in the morning.
We can pray before we eat.
We can pray at night.
We thank God in our prayers.
We ask God for help in our prayers.
Class activity:
Let us say morning prayers.
Good morning God.
Thank you for today.
Evaluation questions:
What is prayer?
When can we pray?
What should we say in our prayers?
Summary:
Prayer is talking to God in the morning and all day.

topics.title: Jesus loves children
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to tell the story of Jesus and children.
The pupils should be able to sing Jesus loves me.
Introduction:
Jesus loves children very much.
Today we learn about Jesus and children.
Content:
Jesus loved to be with children.
One day people brought children to Jesus.
The disciples tried to stop them.
But Jesus said let the children come to me.
Jesus loves all children.
We can sing Jesus loves me.
Class activity:
Let us sing Jesus loves me.
Jesus loves me this I know.
For the Bible tells me so.
Evaluation questions:
What did Jesus say about children?
How do we know Jesus loves children?
What song can we sing about Jesus?
Summary:
Jesus loves children and wants us to come to Him.

topics.title: Obeying God
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state that we should obey God.
The pupils should be able to tell how to obey God.
Introduction:
God wants us to obey Him.
Today we learn about obeying God.
Introduction:
God wants us to obey Him.
Today we learn about obeying God.
Content:
We should obey God.
We obey God by obeying our parents.
We obey God by obeying our teachers.
We obey God by doing what is right.
God is happy when we obey Him.
Class activity:
Let us tell how we obey God.
I obey when I do my homework.
I obey when I listen to my parents.
Evaluation questions:
Why should we obey God?
How do we obey God?
Who should we obey?
Summary:
We should obey God by obeying parents and teachers.

topics.title: Thanking God
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to count their blessings.
The pupils should be able to sing thank you songs.
Introduction:
We have many things to thank God for.
Today we learn about thanking God.
Content:
We should thank God for our blessings.
Blessings are good things God gives us.
We can thank God with songs.
We can thank God with words.
God loves when we thank Him.
Class activity:
Let us count our blessings.
Thank you God for food.
Thank you God for clothes.
Thank you God for school.
Evaluation questions:
What are blessings?
How do we thank God?
Name one thing to thank God for.
Summary:
We should thank God for all our blessings.

topics.title: The Bible is God's word
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state that the Bible is God's word.
The pupils should be able to tell simple Bible stories.
Introduction:
The Bible is a special book.
Today we learn about the Bible.
Content:
The Bible is God's word.
God told people what to write in the Bible.
The Bible has stories about God.
The Bible teaches us how to live.
We should love the Bible.
Class activity:
Let us hold the Bible.
We will read a simple story.
The story of creation.
Evaluation questions:
What is the Bible?
Who wrote the Bible?
What does the Bible teach us?
Summary:
The Bible is God's word and we should love it.

topics.title: Revision and assessment
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to recall what we learned this term.
The pupils should be able to answer questions about our topics.
Introduction:
Today we revise what we learned this term.
We will sing songs and tell stories.
Content:
We learned that God created the world.
We learned that God loves us.
We learned about prayer.
We learned about obeying God.
We learned about the Bible.
Class activity:
Let us sing songs and tell stories.
We will sing Jesus loves me.
We will tell the story of creation.
Evaluation questions:
Who created the world?
How do we talk to God?
What is the Bible?
Summary:
We have revised what we learned this term.
